_note: Hand-written stand-in for an agent's notes/hypothesis.json (toy example). Written from MANUAL.md alone.
what_it_is: A puck sliding on a table, pushed by a force of at most 1 N per axis. Position and velocity are observed, so the response to a force is an acceleration.
evidence: MANUAL.md: the action is a force, the observation has position and velocity, one step is 0.1 s
MANUAL.md, field note: 'It never quite stays where you leave it'
alternatives_rejected: The action sets the velocity directly: the manual calls it a force, and a puck at rest then would stay at rest, against the field note

mechanisms.name: friction
mechanisms.expect: the puck slows down when not pushed
mechanisms.unknown: viscous or constant, and how strong

mechanisms.name: drift
mechanisms.expect: the field note suggests a constant pull or a disturbance

unknowns_and_experiments.experiment: no force for 10 steps (what moves the puck by itself), then full force along +x, pause, full force along -y, pause, half force on both axes
the opposite directions and both axes at once, with pauses, to separate friction from drift
the controller obtained in the model, end to end
